cases.title: A chat platform built around regional access.
cases.summary: Comparing chat platforms, selecting Chatwoot and planning a self-hosted regional pilot.
cases.preview: Compared platforms and planned a self-hosted Chatwoot regional pilot.
cases.contribution: Comparison, requirements, stakeholder alignment and release planning.

sections.title: Context & constraints
paragraphs: Regional availability was a key constraint in the choice of a chat platform. The work considered alternative solutions and the option of self-hosting.

sections.title: My role
paragraphs: My contribution covered comparing options, defining requirements, aligning the choice with stakeholders and preparing the release plan.

sections.title: Analysis & decisions
paragraphs: The comparison led to the selection of Chatwoot. Self-hosting was chosen to address regional availability.

sections.title: Implementation
paragraphs: The agreed direction was translated into a release plan and a regional pilot. The confirmed delivery stage is a regional pilot.

sections.title: Confirmed outcome
paragraphs: Chatwoot was selected and taken into a self-hosted regional pilot.

cases.title: A common framework for assessing quality.
cases.summary: A Google Sheets assessment system with weighted criteria, shared rules and privacy for bonus information.
cases.preview: Weighted assessment criteria for two departments and more than 30 people.
cases.contribution: Weighted criteria and rules, result comparison, privacy and synchronisation.

sections.title: Context & constraints
paragraphs: The quality assessment system covers two departments and more than 30 people in total. Bonus-related information needed to remain private.

sections.title: My role
paragraphs: My work brought together assessment criteria, their weights and the rules used to interpret results. Comparison and synchronisation were part of the system.

sections.title: Analysis & decisions
paragraphs: The system uses weighted criteria rather than an unqualified total. Rules support comparison of results, while access to bonus information remains separate.

sections.title: Implementation
paragraphs: Google Sheets was used for the assessment system, including result comparison, synchronisation and privacy for bonus information.

sections.title: Confirmed outcome
paragraphs: The assessment system spans two departments and more than 30 people.

cases.title: Finding the sequence behind a data defect.
cases.summary: Comparing successful and failed records to identify a process-sequence error and give developers a clear finding.
cases.preview: Record comparison uncovered a sequence error for developers to resolve.
cases.contribution: Record comparison, process analysis and findings for developers.

sections.title: Context & constraints
paragraphs: Some records passed through the data exchange process successfully while others failed. The defect also created a need for manual corrections.

sections.title: My role
paragraphs: I compared successful and unsuccessful records and investigated the sequence of the process. I then provided the findings to developers.

sections.title: Analysis & decisions
paragraphs: The comparison revealed an error in the order of process operations. This connected the failed records to a specific process-sequence issue.

sections.title: Implementation
paragraphs: Developers changed the process using the analytical findings. The analysis and the implementation are distinct contributions.

sections.title: Confirmed outcome
paragraphs: The developers’ process change eliminated the defect and its associated manual corrections.

cases.title: Payment presets, easier to find and keep current.
cases.summary: An internal tool combining search, favourite payment presets and automated updates.
cases.preview: Search, favourite payment presets and automated updates. Access for 80+ staff.
cases.contribution: Search, favourites and automation of preset updates.

sections.title: Context & constraints
paragraphs: The internal tool makes payment presets available to customer-facing teams. Access extends to more than 80 customer-facing employees.

sections.title: My role
paragraphs: Work on the tool brought together searching for presets, keeping favourites and automating updates.

sections.title: Analysis & decisions
paragraphs: Search and favourites provide two ways to retrieve presets. Automated updates support keeping the information current.

sections.title: Implementation
paragraphs: The resulting internal tool includes preset search, favourites and automated updates. Teams and management use it in their daily work.

sections.title: Confirmed outcome
paragraphs: The tool is used daily by teams and management, with access available to 80+ customer-facing employees.
